summary: Phase 38 frontend-only verification complete. All three curriculum UX fixes verified live on LPGS as teacher prasad27@lpgs.com + admin@lpgs.com. (1) DROP-ZONE in CREATE mode: opened Create curriculum on empty Grade 9 · Mathematics — Step 1 renders the large dashed drop-zone [data-testid=ai-wiz-textbook-dropzone] with 'Click to upload textbook / PDF, DOCX or TXT · up to 60MB'; Next:Chapters is disabled (title + file required). After uploading a .txt via ai-wiz-textbook-file and setting title='QA DropZone Textbook', the picker swapped to ai-wiz-textbook-picked showing filename+size with Change/Remove, and Next:Chapters became enabled. In EDIT mode (resuming the live Grade 9 draft that has no textbook item), Step 1 renders the drop-zone again plus the new amber hint 'No textbook saved on this draft — upload one using the box below.' (the exact hardening suggestion from iter_23 code review was shipped). (2) DELETE DRAFT: Grade 9 draft row showed Edit/resume + Submit for approval + rose 'Delete draft' [data-testid=ai-delete-draft-btn] + View full curriculum. Clicking Delete draft → confirm → toast 'Draft deleted' → view returned to the empty state with [ai-create-curriculum-btn]. Negative-tests: Grade 10 · Mathematics (PENDING) and Grade 8 · Mathematics (PUBLISHED) both correctly OMIT ai-delete-draft-btn (count=0 on each). The ai-detail-delete-draft button is also present on the detail page for a draft. (3) FULL-PAGE DETAIL: Teacher 'View full curriculum' navigates to /teacher/ai-tutor/curriculum/{id} rendering a true full page with [ai-curriculum-detail-page-wrap], [ai-detail-back], [ai-curriculum-detail-page] and [ai-detail-delete-draft] — NO fixed/overlay drawer detected. Back button returns to /teacher/ai-tutor. Admin side: logged in as admin@lpgs.com, /app/ai-tutor → 'Pending curricula' → 'Full detail' button navigated to /app/ai-tutor/curriculum/{id} as a full page with reviewer actions (Approve/Changes/Reject, Delete curriculum, chapter/textbook approve/reject/comment, mention bar). Regression: ai-create-curriculum-btn + wizard Step 1→2 (ai-add-chapter + ai-chapter-0) still work. LPGS left clean — the Grade 9 draft and the test draft I created were both deleted via ai-delete-draft-btn; Grade 10 pending and Grade 8 published were untouched.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: visual-editor instrumentation injects <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> (React warns span cannot be child of option). Non-functional, carried over from prior iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: CurriculumDetailPage.jsx uses navigate(-1) for Back — if a user deep-links to the detail URL directly (new tab, email link), Back would exit the app (no history entry). Minor UX hardening: fallback to navigate('/teacher/ai-tutor' or '/app/ai-tutor') when window.history.length <= 1.

Hydration warning around <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option> in AITutorTeacher.jsx subjects <select> keeps logging on every render — this is tooling instrumentation, but still noisy. Consider rendering raw text (not an interpolation expression) in <option>s to avoid the visual-editor wrapper.
